note: Holmgren's 1913 complete redescription based on Haviland's type material (in German; placed in the original under Hamitermes (Globitermes)). The original description is Haviland 1898 (Termes globosus), and this entry follows the redescription, which includes three castes. The original was extracted by OCR from an Internet Archive scan; some numbers were misread and have been checked against the context.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head and pronotum dark chestnut brown; the basal piece of the postclypeus, the antennae and the rest of the dorsal surface paler; venter paler; tibiae brownish; wings brownish yellow. Pilosity dense. Head broadly oval, narrowing anteriorly; compound eyes of medium size, not much projecting; ocelli rather small, the distance to the compound eye hardly exceeding their diameter; fontanelle indistinct, situated slightly behind the middle; basal piece of the postclypeus very short and flat; antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 equal to segments 3+4, segment 3 very short. Anterior margin of the pronotum very weakly concave, the posterior margin slightly concave; posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum nearly straight; no veins between the radial sector and the media; media single or forked; cubitus with about 9—12 branches, of which about 6 inner branches are thickened.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Two forms occur, large and small, with intermediates. Head brownish yellow, mandibles brown, body white. Head with a few setae; abdominal tergites densely covered with rather long hairs. Head wider than long, almost perfectly circular, thick; fontanelle about in the middle of the head, indistinct, with a fontanelle plate; basal piece of the postclypeus very short and flat; labrum slightly triangular, pointed at the apex, short; mandibles strongly curved, long and slender, with a long backward-directed tooth behind the middle; the mandibles of small soldiers are longer and more slender than those of large ones; antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 equal to segments 3+4 in large soldiers and slightly shorter in small ones; segment 3 equal to segment 4 and short; the anterior part of the postmentum (submentum) strongly inflated like a process. Pronotum saddle-shaped, not concave; abdomen very thick, almost spherical.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head yellow, body white. Head and body rather densely hairy. Head slightly pentagonal and round; fontanelle about in the middle of the head; basal piece of the postclypeus very short, flatly convex; antennae 14-segmented, as in the soldier; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin not concave.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm). Alate: length with wings 9; body length without wings 5.6; fore wing length 7—7.6; head length 1.4; head width 0.99; pronotum width 0.8, length 0.46. Soldier (large/small): body length 3.5/3.2; head length with mandibles 1.52/1.41; head length without mandibles 0.8/0.66; head width 0.95/0.76; pronotum width 0.61/0.49. Worker: body length 3.3—3.5; head width 0.87; pronotum width 0.49. Distribution: Borneo, Mt Lambir, Sarawak (Haviland, Hose).
